docs.text: Internal Access model for the Kids First Data Resource Center

docs.title: Custom Artifact Generation (dbt)
docs.text:
We have a handful of custom scripts that build various artifacts required by different components of the various data pipeline components. These should all be handled by the CI/CD pipeline and added to the release's Assets list.

  • The SQL Alchemy model is available directly from the assets list as a whl file and can be added to your python distribution using @git+{url} syntax.
  • The all artifacts generated by the just site recipe can be found inside the release assets' project_artifacts.zip file.

To trigger the production of these assets, a new release should be created with a semantic version based tag that starts with v: v1.0.0, etc.

docs.title: The dbt Recipe
docs.text:
A dumb wrapper recipe has been created with dependencies to trigger the production of each of those dbt related artifacts.

This recipe has been added as a dependency of the standard recipe, site.

just dbt

Example command to add the model to your uv based python project:

uv add common_access_model@https://github.com/include-dcc/common-access-model/releases/download/0.0.1/common_access_model-0.0.0.post89.dev0+d378cee-py3-none-any.whl

Please note the releases/download/0.0.1 portion of the url. That is to a specific version of the model itself, which is by design. You will need to update your project each time you want to update to a new model.

In a similar fashion, you can install it via pip or add it to your pyproject.toml file using a similar pattern.

docs.title: SQL Alchemy Model
docs.text:
Many of our tools rely on the SQL Alchemy models produced using LinkML's SQL Alchemy generator. We've added just recipe's to run build these:

just sqla

The resulting file is found inside project/sqlalchemy/{model_name}.py

docs.title: Data Dictionary csv files
docs.text:
The pipeline utitilies created by the FTD team rely on csv data dictionaries to the target .sql files.

just _gen_ftddd

Resulting csv files can be found inside: project/data-dictionary/*.csv

Each class from the model and any of the SQL specific join tables will be found in their own file, conforming to the FTD DD Format.

docs.title: Model Enums
docs.text:
This is a CSV file that contains each enumeration and it's home within the datamodel. It is used by the dbt pipeline utitilies. This is a secondary artifact from the _gen_ftddd recipe.

The resulting file is found inside project/enumerations/model_enums.csv

docs.title: dbt Model
docs.text:
A complete model that can be immediately dropped into your dbt pipeline can be generated that features various dbt tests based on the model's definition including:

  • valid_uri_format
  • foreign key target must exist
  • uri-or-curie
  • multi-column keys
  • not null
  • unique
  • allowable values

The resulting file is found inside project/dbt/src_dev_include_access.yml

The filename is purely a placeholder and should be renamed to whatever makes sense for your needs.

docs.title: kf-access-model
docs.text:
Internal Access model for the Kids First Data Resource Center.

This schema profiles the common-access-model (cam) for data hosted in the Kids First Dataservice. Every Dataservice-sourced class descends from KFRecord (itself is_a cam:Record), which supplies the Dataservice's own kf_id identifier plus its per-record visibility/access-control fields. Where cam already models the concept (Investigator, Study, Family, FamilyRelationship, Sample), the corresponding KF class is_a KFRecord and also mixins the matching cam class, so it implements/reuses cam's fields directly. Where the Dataservice models a concept cam does not (Participant, Diagnosis, Phenotype, Outcome, Biospecimen, GenomicFile, ReadGroup, SequencingExperiment, SequencingCenter, and the various join entities), the KF class is_a KFRecord only.

URI: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model

Name: kf-access-model

docs.title: Class: Participant (KFParticipant)
docs.text:
A study participant. Combines the roles of cam:Subject and cam:Demographics into a single record, matching the Kids First Dataservice's participants entity. No mixin is used here because the Dataservice's own fields (gender, race, ethnicity, species recorded directly on the participant) don't line up cleanly with cam:Subject/cam:Demographics's required fields (subject_type, sex).

name: KFStudy
description: Study metadata. is_a KFRecord and mixins (implements) cam:Study, adding
  the Dataservice's own fields on top.
title: Study
from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
is_a: KFRecord
mixins:
- Study
slot_usage:
  study_id:
    name: study_id
    description: Overridden from common-access-model. Kids First studies are identified
      by kf_id (see KFRecord); this mixed-in slot is not used as the study's own identifier
      here.
    identifier: false
    range: string
    required: false
  parent_study:
    name: parent_study
    description: The parent KFStudy for this study, if it is a nested study.
    range: KFStudy
  principal_investigator:
    name: principal_investigator
    description: The KFInvestigator(s) responsible for the study.
    range: KFInvestigator
  contact:
    name: contact
    description: The KFInvestigator(s) to contact with questions about this study.
    range: KFInvestigator
attributes:
  data_access_authority:
    name: data_access_authority
    description: The authority governing access to this study's data, eg, dbGaP.
    title: Data Access Authority
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: data_access_authority
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: EnumDataAccessAuthority
  investigator_id:
    name: investigator_id
    description: The primary Investigator for this study.
    title: Investigator ID
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: investigator_id
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: KFInvestigator
  name:
    name: name
    description: Name of the entity.
    title: Name
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: name
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    - KFSequencingCenter
    - VirtualBiorepository
    - Investigator
    - EncounterDefinition
    - ActivityDefinition
    - Dataset
    range: string
    required: false
  short_name:
    name: short_name
    description: A short name for the study.
    title: Short Name
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: short_name
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: string
  version:
    name: version
    description: The version of this study's data.
    title: Version
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: version
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: string
  file_version_descriptor:
    name: file_version_descriptor
    description: A descriptor distinguishing this record's data version from others.
    title: File Version Descriptor
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: file_version_descriptor
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    - KFGenomicFile
    range: string
  attribution:
    name: attribution
    description: Text describing how to attribute use of this study's data.
    title: Attribution
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: attribution
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: string
  category:
    name: category
    description: The broad category of research this study addresses.
    title: Study Category
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: category
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: EnumStudyCategory
  status:
    name: status
    description: The processing/release status of this study.
    title: Study Status
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: status
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFStudy
    range: EnumStudyStatus
  parent_study:
    name: parent_study
    description: The parent KFStudy for this study, if it is a nested study.
    title: Parent Study
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: parent_study
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: KFStudy
    required: false
    multivalued: false
  study_title:
    name: study_title
    description: Full Study Title
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: study_title
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
    required: true
    multivalued: false
  study_code:
    name: study_code
    description: Unique identifier for the study (generally a short acronym)
    title: Study Code
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: study_code
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
    required: true
  study_short_name:
    name: study_short_name
    description: Short name for the study
    title: Study Code
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: study_short_name
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
    required: false
  program:
    name: program
    description: Funding source(s) for the study
    title: Program
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: program
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: EnumProgram
    required: true
    multivalued: true
  funding_source:
    name: funding_source
    description: The funding source(s) of the study.
    title: Funding Source
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: funding_source
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  principal_investigator:
    name: principal_investigator
    description: The KFInvestigator(s) responsible for the study.
    title: Principal Investigator
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: principal_investigator
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: KFInvestigator
    required: true
    multivalued: true
  contact:
    name: contact
    description: The KFInvestigator(s) to contact with questions about this study.
    title: Contact Person
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: contact
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    - VirtualBiorepository
    range: KFInvestigator
    required: true
    multivalued: true
  study_description:
    name: study_description
    description: Brief description of the study (2-4 sentences)
    title: Study Description
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: study_description
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
    required: true
  website:
    name: website
    description: Website with more information about this entity.
    title: Website
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: website
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - AccessPolicy
    - Study
    - VirtualBiorepository
    - Publication
    range: uri
  publication:
    name: publication
    description: Publications associated with this Record.
    title: Publication
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: publication
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    - Dataset
    range: Publication
    multivalued: true
  acknowledgments:
    name: acknowledgments
    description: Funding statement and acknowledgments for this study
    title: Acknowledgments
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: acknowledgments
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
  citation_statement:
    name: citation_statement
    description: Statement that secondary data users should use to acknowledge use
      of this study or dataset. E.g., "The results analyzed and <published or shown>
      here are based in whole or in part upon data generated by the INCLUDE (INvestigation
      of Co-occurring conditions across the Lifespan to Understand Down syndromE)
      Project <insert accession number(s) and/or study DOI(s)>, and were accessed
      from the INCLUDE Data Hub and <insert other database(s)>."
    title: Citation Statement
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: citation_statement
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    range: string
  do_id:
    name: do_id
    description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for this Record.
    title: DOI
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: do_id
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Study
    - DOI
    - Dataset
    range: DOI
    multivalued: false
  kf_id:
    name: kf_id
    description: Kids First Dataservice identifier for this record, eg, PT_00000000.
    title: KF ID
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    identifier: true
    alias: kf_id
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFRecord
    range: string
    required: true
    pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}_[A-Z0-9]{8}$
  visible:
    name: visible
    description: Whether this record is visible/released, per Kids First Dataservice
      access control.
    title: Visible
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: visible
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFRecord
    range: boolean
  visibility_comment:
    name: visibility_comment
    description: Free-text explanation supporting visibility_reason.
    title: Visibility Comment
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: visibility_comment
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFRecord
    range: string
  visibility_reason:
    name: visibility_reason
    description: The reason this record is or is not visible.
    title: Visibility Reason
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: visibility_reason
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - KFRecord
    range: EnumVisibilityReason
  external_id:
    name: external_id
    description: Other identifiers for this entity, eg, from the submitting study
      or in systems like dbGaP
    title: External Identifiers
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: external_id
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Record
    range: uriorcurie
    required: false
    multivalued: true
  access_policy_id:
    name: access_policy_id
    description: Global identifier for the access policy that applies to this row
      of data.
    title: Access Policy ID
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    alias: access_policy_id
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Record
    - AccessPolicy
    range: AccessPolicy
  study_id:
    name: study_id
    description: Overridden from common-access-model. Kids First studies are identified
      by kf_id (see KFRecord); this mixed-in slot is not used as the study's own identifier
      here.
    title: Study ID
    from_schema: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model
    rank: 1000
    identifier: false
    alias: study_id
    owner: KFStudy
    domain_of:
    - Record
    - StudyMetadata
    range: string
    required: false
    multivalued: false

docs.title: kf-access-model
docs.text:
Internal Access model for the Kids First Data Resource Center.

This schema profiles the common-access-model (cam) for data hosted in the Kids First Dataservice. Every Dataservice-sourced class descends from KFRecord (itself is_a cam:Record), which supplies the Dataservice's own kf_id identifier plus its per-record visibility/access-control fields. Where cam already models the concept (Investigator, Study, Family, FamilyRelationship, Sample), the corresponding KF class is_a KFRecord and also mixins the matching cam class, so it implements/reuses cam's fields directly. Where the Dataservice models a concept cam does not (Participant, Diagnosis, Phenotype, Outcome, Biospecimen, GenomicFile, ReadGroup, SequencingExperiment, SequencingCenter, and the various join entities), the KF class is_a KFRecord only.

URI: https://w3id.org/carrollaboratory/kf-access-model

docs.title: Slot: KF ID (kf_id)
docs.text:

docs.title: Applicable Classes
docs.text: Name Description Modifies Slot KFSequencingCenter An organization that performs sequencing for a study no KFOutcome The latest recorded vital-status outcome for a Participant no KFBiospecimen A specific specimen/aliquot derived from a Sample, carrying material, consent... no KFRecord Abstract base for every record sourced from the Kids First Dataservice yes KFFamily A group of individuals of some relation who are grouped together in a study no KFFamilyRelationship A relationship between two Participants no KFBiospecimenDiagnosis Links a Biospecimen to a Diagnosis it is associated with no KFReadGroup Sequencing read group (flow cell / lane) metadata no KFPhenotype A phenotypic feature observed (or explicitly not observed) for a Participant no KFGenomicFile A data file generated by or associated with sequencing no KFBiospecimenGenomicFile Links a Biospecimen to a GenomicFile it produced no KFParticipant A study participant no KFSequencingExperimentGenomicFile Links a SequencingExperiment to a GenomicFile it produced no KFSequencingExperiment A sequencing experiment performed on a Biospecimen no KFSample A grouping of Biospecimens collected from a Participant at the same event no KFDiagnosis A diagnosis event or assertion recorded for a Participant no KFStudy Study metadata no KFSampleRelationship A parent/child derivation relationship between two Samples no KFReadGroupGenomicFile Links a ReadGroup to a GenomicFile it produced no KFInvestigator An individual who made contributions to the collection, analysis, or sharing ... no
